verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a plugin system: the README points to an Excalidraw canvas-collaboration example covering plugin install/update, a page API and host integration. That suggests ZCode can be extended, but it reads as workbench/UI extension rather than a way to give the agent specialized skills. missing for 10: an explicit custom-skills or agent-capability authoring mechanism, documentation on defining and loading skills for specialized tasks, and independent or hands-on confirmation that plugins extend agent behavior.
